_note: 以下法定假期数字来自 Employment Act (Cap. 91)。来源URL由用户投喂。具体法条编号未逐条验证，不得引用为确定条款号。
_unverified_fields: part_iv_classification: 来自用户修正指令，未绑定EA具体条款

paid_sick_leave.relationship: 60天住院病假已包含14天门诊病假——不是14+60=74天。员工在calendar year内先后使用门诊和住院病假时，总额以60天为上限

shared_parental_leave.usage_window: 子女出生后12个月内使用

childcare_leave.condition: 7岁以下新加坡公民子女，政府支付前3天

retirement_age._data_source: Retirement and Re-employment Act，训练记忆

public_holiday._data_source: 用户修正指令 — PH规则由用户提供官方正确规则后嵌入
judgment_chain: Employment Act Coverage → Public Holiday Entitlement
Holiday falls on Working Day / Non-Working Day / Rest Day
Applicable Holiday Payment or Day-Off Treatment

payment_bases.paid_public_holiday: Gross rate of pay（月薪员工holiday pay已含在monthly gross rate中）
payment_bases.additional_pay_for_working_on_ph: Basic rate of pay（额外一天）
payment_bases.ph_non_working_day: Another day off 或 extra day's salary at gross rate

forbidden: Part IV覆盖员工适用OT、Rest Day和PH法定规则
PH工作按Gross Rate计算（需先识别具体支付项目再确定basis）
将OT/Rest Day/PH统一归入Part IV计算体系

part_iv_classification._data_source: 用户修正指令 — Part IV分类规则由用户提供官方正确规则后嵌入
judgment_chain: Employee Actual Duties → Workman or Non-workman
Monthly Basic Salary → Part IV Applicability

thresholds.workman: Monthly basic salary不超过S$4,500时进入Part IV覆盖判断
thresholds.non_workman: Monthly basic salary不超过S$2,600时进入Part IV覆盖判断

manager_or_executive.part_iv_coverage: 不受Part IV关于hours of work/overtime/rest day的规则覆盖
manager_or_executive.determination: 根据实际工作职责判断，不能只看职位名称。考虑executive/supervisory functions、招聘/纪律/解雇/绩效/奖励决策权、专业性职责

forbidden: 使用PME作为Part IV法定三分类
PME = 不受Part IV保护（作为固定规则）
仅根据Job Title判断Manager or Executive
